subject.title: improve: reduce GPT-5.6 coding harness overhead

question: Should the private-QA Codex runtime intentionally override only danger-full-access to workspace-write, excluding `/tmp` and `TMPDIR`, as the permanent containment policy for this QA path?
rationale: The change is intentionally security-sensitive and changes sandbox behavior under existing build/runtime gates; tests and hosted proof support it, but only maintainers can approve that policy boundary and its upgrade/operational tradeoff.

options.title: Approve the scoped QA confinement
options.body: Confirm that the two existing private-QA gates are the intended owner boundary and merge after the rebased targeted proof and dependency review pass.

options.title: Keep ordinary yolo semantics in private QA
options.body: Retain the current writable-root behavior and revise the containment scenario to use an isolated workspace strategy instead of narrowing Codex sandbox roots.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped QA confinement
recommendation.body: Confirm that the two existing private-QA gates are the intended owner boundary and merge after the rebased targeted proof and dependency review pass.
